target.title: fix(models): preserve static catalog provider metadata
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Static provider catalog conversion did not preserve all provider/model metadata consistently. The concrete current-main gap is provider-level `params`: static-catalog rows can define provider request params, but the returned runtime model did not merge those provider params with model params.

This PR also makes the static-catalog converter explicitly carry `compat` and `mediaInput` so the returned runtime model preserves the same schema-valid metadata downstream payload and capability code expects.

## Why This Change Was Made

The runtime should preserve schema-valid provider/model metadata when resolving static provider catalog models. This is a narrow metadata-preservation fix in `modelFromProviderStaticCatalog`; it does not add a new config key, policy path, transport, or custom-provider tool API.

Reviewer note:
- Treat this as static-catalog params/metadata preservation.
- Do not treat it as a fully proven root-cause fix for all custom-provider tool-support failures.
- Current main already keeps normal configured-provider compat flowing in other paths, and tools are permissive unless `compat.supportsTools === false`.

## User Impact

Users and bundled/provider catalogs can define provider-level request params and model metadata without losing that metadata during static-catalog model resolution. Downstream payload generation and capability checks then receive the resolved model shape consistently.

## Evidence

Behavior or issue addressed:
- Static provider catalog conversion merges provider-level and model-level `params`, with model-level values taking precedence.
- Static provider catalog conversion preserves model `compat` metadata.
- Static provider catalog conversion preserves model `mediaInput` metadata.
- Regression coverage verifies that a resolved model with `compat.supportsTools=true` remains tool-capable through `supportsModelTools(model)`.
- Regression coverage verifies that OpenAI completions payload construction keeps tool definitions when the resolved model metadata says tools are supported.

- The PR branch is currently behind `main` because upstream advanced after the branch was cut.
- `base_is_ancestor_of_head=1` means the current upstream base is not contained in this branch, which explains GitHub's "This branch is out-of-date with the base branch" banner.

Targeted regression coverage added:
- `src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/model.static-catalog.test.ts`: static catalog model conversion preserves `compat`, `mediaInput`, and merged `params`.
- `src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/model.test.ts`: resolved model `compat.supportsTools=true` remains tool-capable through `supportsModelTools(model)`.
- `src/agents/openai-transport-stream.test.ts`: OpenAI completions payload keeps the `exec` tool when model compat sets `supportsTools=true`.

Verification caveat:
- A later live gateway smoke rerun did **not** prove actual tool execution; it exposed a separate live session/tool exposure issue where the runtime returned `Tool exec not found`. That output is intentionally not used as proof for this PR.
